name: 5-TOET
summary: 5-TOET, also known as 2-methoxy-4-ethyl-5-methylthioamphetamine or as 5-thio-DOET, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and amphetamine families related to the DOx psychedelic DOET. It is the analogue of DOET in which the methoxy group at the 5 position has been replaced with a methylthio group. The drug is one of two possible TOET (thio-DOET) positional isomers, the other being 2-TOET.

pharmacology.en: Like other DOx psychedelics, it is thought to act on the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, the main target of classic psychedelics.
pharmacology.zh: 一般認為它和其他DOx類迷幻藥一樣，作用於血清素5-HT2A受體，也就是經典迷幻藥的主要作用目標。
pharmacology.zhHans: 一般认为它和其他DOx类迷幻药一样，作用于血清素5-HT2A受体，也就是经典迷幻药的主要作用目标。

uses.en: It was described by Alexander Shulgin in his book PiHKAL and has rarely been used outside that work.
uses.zh: Alexander Shulgin在著作《PiHKAL》中描述過它，除此之外很少有人使用。
uses.zhHans: Alexander Shulgin在著作《PiHKAL》中描述过它，除此之外很少有人使用。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic phenethylamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, a faster heartbeat, raised blood pressure, muscle tension, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻苯乙胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、心跳加快、血壓升高、肌肉緊繃、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻苯乙胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、心跳加快、血压升高、肌肉紧绷、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: DOET, the drug it is based on, was studied by Alexander Shulgin and colleagues in the 1960s. 5-TOET swaps one of its methoxy groups for a sulphur-linked methyl group.
fact.zh: 它所基於的藥物DOET，在1960年代由Alexander Shulgin與同事研究過。5-TOET則把其中一個甲氧基換成經由硫相連的甲基。
fact.zhHans: 它所基于的药物DOET，在1960年代由Alexander Shulgin与同事研究过。5-TOET则把其中一个甲氧基换成经由硫相连的甲基。
